diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Waveshare gives 3.3 V only as the nominal working voltage, while the module schematic ties VCC straight to the SH1107 VDD (no regulator) and the SH1107 datasheet lists 'Logic voltage supply: VDD = 1.65V - 3.5V' (the on-board TPS61040 boost runs from 1.8 V), so a 3.0 V lower bound around the 3.3 V nominal is safe and conservative.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 3.5 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: VCC feeds the SH1107 VDD directly (Waveshare schematic, no regulator), and the SH1107 datasheet DC characteristics give 'Operating voltage                   1.65       -       3.5' V (absolute max 3.6 V), so 3.5 V is the true upper limit while the 3.3 V of the second reading is just Waveshare's nominal 'Power input(3.3V)'.
